findings.detail: SB 1071 exists only in the 2025-2026 session; amends Titles 18/53 (police conduct), not health insurance. Likely candidates for what was intended: SB 50 and SB 1195 (2025-2026), both health-insurance-related -- NOT independently verified this pass, flag for next check.
